Garden Maintenance Sydney — Regular Upkeep for Homes, Strata & Commercial

Scheduled garden upkeep: pruning, weeding, mulching, bed tidy-ups and green waste removal for homes, strata and commercial grounds.

Get a Free Quote 0452 586 355

Garden maintenance in Sydney is easy to get quoted and hard to get done well. Greater Sydney Landscapes looks after gardens on a regular schedule for homeowners, strata committees and commercial property managers across Parramatta, The Hills, Blacktown and the Inner West, so the grounds look cared for every week of the year, not just the week before an inspection.

Residential garden maintenance that keeps up with Sydney growth

Sydney gardens grow fast. Left for a season, beds fill with weeds, shrubs lose their shape and mulch disappears. Our regular garden maintenance service in Sydney covers pruning, weeding, mulching, edging and a general tidy-up on a fortnightly or monthly visit, with hedge trimming and lawn mowing bundled in if you want one crew handling the whole property. We work with what you have planted, keep natives and established trees healthy, and take every bit of green waste away.

Strata garden maintenance in Parramatta and Western Sydney

Strata managers and body corporates need grounds that look consistent and a contractor who turns up without reminders. We maintain common-area gardens, nature strips, entry plantings and lawns for apartment blocks and townhouse complexes around Parramatta, Westmead, Blacktown and The Hills on a fixed schedule with a single monthly invoice. Pressure washing of common paths and driveways can be added to the same contract.

Commercial grounds maintenance

Offices, medical centres, childcare centres, churches and retail sites across Western Sydney use us for scheduled grounds maintenance. We keep frontages presentable, paths and car parks clear of weeds and leaf litter, and garden beds mulched and tidy. We are fully insured and happy to work to a site induction or specific access hours.

What’s included

  • Pruning and shaping shrubs and small trees
  • Weeding garden beds and paved areas
  • Mulching and bed top-ups
  • Seasonal tidy-ups and leaf removal
  • Strata and commercial grounds on a fixed schedule
  • All green waste removed

Garden Maintenance FAQs

Can you handle regular garden maintenance for strata blocks in Parramatta?

Yes. We maintain common-area gardens, lawns and nature strips for strata and townhouse complexes around Parramatta, Westmead and Blacktown on a fixed fortnightly or monthly schedule with one monthly invoice.

What is included in a garden maintenance visit?

A typical visit covers pruning and shaping, weeding beds and paved areas, edging, a general tidy-up and green waste removal. Mulching, hedge trimming, lawn mowing and fertilising can be added to the same visit.

How often do gardens in Sydney need maintenance?

Most established gardens stay in good shape on a monthly visit, with fortnightly visits through spring and summer when growth is fastest. We will recommend a schedule when we see the garden.

Do you do one-off garden clean-ups?

We do. If a garden has got away from you, we can do a one-off tidy-up and then move you onto a regular schedule so it never gets to that point again.
